title: Eleven Minutes of Darkness
subtitle: 星辰天体 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 星辰天体（宇宙探索·星辰与天体）
meta: 主题语境：星辰天体（宇宙探索·星辰与天体）　|　核心词汇：light　|　正文 381 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 light 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: My great-uncle kept a telescope in a shed and a rule about ① light: no lamp was ever switched on within fifty metres of it after six o'clock. Light, he used to say, arrives before it is invited. He was a night-shift baker who had looked up one night in 1961 and never stopped. What he understood, and what took me years to understand, is that the ② light of a star is old news, and that looking at it is a kind of reading.

The village fought him for eleven years. In ③ light of the complaints — the hedge, the shed, the noise of the shed — the council ordered him to keep the lamp off and the lid on. He obeyed the lamp and ignored the lid. His own ④ light on the subject was simple: a village that has forgotten the sky will not miss it, and will not forgive the person who reminds it.

I was allowed out with him from the age of nine. The ⑤ light of the shed was a red torch, because red does not undo your eyes, and the walk across the garden was done in the dark, slowly, with a hand on my shoulder. He ⑥ lit nothing else. Every light in that village, he said once, is a small act of forgetting. In summer the sky was never properly dark, and he said the ⑦ light of a June night is the worst kind of pollution, because nobody notices it.

He showed me three things and made me find the rest. Saturn, in 1988, was a ⑧ light the colour of old paper, and I did not believe it. He said that was the correct reaction. The ⑨ light grey smear he cared about most was the faint one, the kind you can only see by looking slightly away from it.

He died in 1994 and the telescope went to a school, where the lens has never been cleaned and the corridor light is switched on at dusk and off at midnight. I have a telescope now, a better one, and I use it perhaps four times a year, usually in ⑩ light snow, when the air is still. What I kept instead was the habit of standing still for eleven minutes, which is how long an eye takes.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: C. adj. 淡的；浅色的（light colour）
D. adj. 轻微的；少量的（light rain）
E. v. 点亮；点燃（light sth）
F. 固定搭配：in light of 鉴于；考虑到
G. n. （看待事物的）角度；见解（one's light on）
H. n. 天体；发光体（星辰）

items.q: the light of a star is old news
His own light on the subject
The light of the shed was a red torch
the light of a June night
Saturn, in 1988, was a light the colour of old paper
The light grey smear he cared about most was the faint one
usually in light snow, when the air is still

answers.why: 指“光、灯光”，他的规矩是望远镜五十米内傍晚后不准开灯。
指星光，说恒星的光是“旧消息”，因为它走了很多年才到达。
in light of 意为“鉴于、考虑到”，说议会鉴于投诉作出要求。
one's light on the subject 指“某人对这件事的看法、角度”。
指棚里的“光源”是一只红色手电，因为红光不破坏夜视。
light 作动词，意为“点亮”，说他除了手电什么也不点。
指六月的夜“光”，说它是最糟的一种污染，因为没人察觉。
指土星这个“发光体、天体”，颜色像旧纸。
light grey 意为“浅灰色的”，light 作形容词表颜色浅、淡。
light snow 意为“小雪、轻微的雪”，light 作形容词表程度轻。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 他的规矩是：望远镜五十米内不准开灯。（light）
恒星的光是旧消息，因为它走了很多年。（light）
鉴于那些投诉，议会要求他熄灯盖镜头。（in light of）
棚里唯一的光源是一只红色手电。（light）
除了手电，他什么也不点。（light v.）
土星在1988年是一个旧纸颜色的光点。（light）
answers: His rule about light was that no lamp be switched on within fifty metres of the telescope.
The light of a star is old news, because it has travelled for many years.
In light of the complaints, the council ordered him to keep the lamp off.
The only light in the shed was a red torch.
He lit nothing else except the torch.
In 1988 Saturn was a light the colour of old paper.
